title: AI Legal Program Manager
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
 The Role
 As AI Legal Program Manager, you will play a key role in navigating the legal and regulatory landscape of Block's artificial intelligence initiatives. You will partner with legal, engineering, product, and compliance teams to develop frameworks that enable responsible AI innovation while ensuring regulatory compliance and risk management across our AI products and services.
 You will:
 Drive the development and implementation of AI legal and compliance frameworks, including policies for model development, deployment, and monitoring that align with emerging AI regulations and industry standards.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:

title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
description:
Unser Mandant hat seinen Stammsitz im Harz und zählt zu den international führenden Anbietern technologisch anspruchsvoller Systemlösungen für industrielle Anwendungen. Seit mehreren Jahrzehnten entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt das hochinnovative Unternehmen Geräte und Systeme, die weltweit in unterschiedlichsten Branchen zur Qualitätssicherung und Prozessoptimierung eingesetzt werden.
 Mit einer Belegschaft von rund 200 Mitarbeitenden inkl. der internationalen Standorte steht das Unternehmen für Präzision, Innovationskraft und Verlässlichkeit. Forschung, Entwicklung und Fertigung erfolgen am Hauptsitz in Deutschland. Die Kombination aus technologischem Know-how, wissenschaftlicher Kompetenz und praxisorientiertem Denken macht unseren Mandanten zu einem geschätzten Partner in Industrie und Wissenschaft. Mitarbeiter*innen, Lieferanten und Geschäftspartner schätzen die langfristige Orientierung, die familiär geprägte Unternehmenskultur und die hohe Verlässlichkeit – ein Arbeitgeber mit Zukunft, Tradition und Werten.
 Im Zuge einer Nachbesetzung wird zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt ein*e Bilanzbuchhalter*in (m/w/d) gesucht.
 Aufgaben
 Abschlusserstellung und internationales Finanzreporting nach HGB.
 Intercompany-Abstimmungen, Bildung von Rückstellungen, Bewertung von Beständen etc.
 Verantwortung für die reibungslos funktionierende Bilanzbuchhaltung sowohl der Mutter- als auch der Tochtergesellschaften unseres Mandanten.
 Ansprechpartner für Bilanzierungs- und Steuerfragen gegenüber Wirtschaftsprüfern, Steuerberatern, Banken und Behörden.
 Direkte Berichtslinie an die Geschäftsleitung
 Die Übernahme weiterer Themen ist möglich

 Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Studium (z. B. BWL/Wirtschaftswissenschaften); alternativ z. B. Steuerfachangestellter (m/w/d), idealerweise ergänzt um den IHK-Bilanzbuchhalter

title: Performance Marketing Lead
location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Austin, TX; Remote - US
description:
Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done.
 Performance marketing is one of Airtable's biggest growth levers, and a lot of what's possible hasn't been built yet. The Growth Marketing team runs strong core paid channels across self-serve and enterprise, but the next wave of impact will come from new acquisition programs, emerging paid surfaces, and an AI-and-automation-powered operating model that lets a lean team move like a much larger one. This role owns paid end-to-end (strategy, execution, budget allocation, and measurement) and reports to the Head of Growth Marketing.
 What you'll do
 Own full-funnel paid campaigns across self-serve and enterprise, from awareness through conversion.
 Stand up new acquisition programs from scratch (sponsorships, creator/UGC, influencer partnerships) and turn the ones that work into repeatable, durable engines.
 Explore emerging paid channels, including agentic surfaces like AI answer engines and marketplaces, and define how Airtable shows up and wins there early.
 Build and iterate on the post-click experience, including landing pages, offers, and messaging by audience and intent, so paid traffic actually converts.
 Put agents and automations at the center of how the team operates.
 Partner across lifecycle, web, GEO, and product to align on the full journey, not just the click or the signup.
 Own the attribution and reporting that connect paid spend through activation and conversion all the way to revenue.
 Who you are
 7+ years in performance marketing, growth, or demand gen, ideally in B2B SaaS.
 You've built new channels or programs from scratch and scaled them, not just optimized what already existed.
